teacher_info.intro:
I'm Vivi & I can totaly understand where you are now. 

I have been there. I have traveled to over 70 countries & met tons of people. Traveling is awesome but it sucks when you could exchange the most amazing & incredible stories & experiences but you get stuck at the basics because of the langauge barrier. 

I lived in Spanish speaking countries and before I started speaking spanish fluently I was just sitting at the table seeming to be under Harry Potter's invisibility cloak & just smiling as the conversation, the gold nuggets & the great info zoomed by me.

It is frustrating and thats why I am here to help you speak fluently & integrate into a culture fully to be part of the story
teacher_info.short_signature: Fun filled German lessons with over 8 years of experience - learn German with ease
teacher_info.introduction: Hey guys I am Vivi from Germany and I speak Spanish, German and Englisch and I am very happy to teach you any of these languages. I love travelling, that’s why I study tourism. I have been to almost 60 countries so I know how it feels like to be in a country as a foreigner, not understanding a single word or struggling with the conversation. I lived in Chile, New Zealand, India, Spain and now I am in Mexico City. During my travels I also learned a lot about different cultures, to do’s and not to do’s . So apart from teaching you a language I find it very important and useful to learn at least a bit about the culture and the behavior of the people as well. I have the experiences of learning languages myself and I also worked as a tutor helping kids and young adults learning a language naturally and preparing for travels or exams. So I also know how to keep people motivated and focused. Due to my travel & teaching experience I also know which kind of mistakes people tend to make and how to avoid them. My classes are very personal & designed to your needs and goals in life. We can work on specific grammar points, vocabulary building, discussions, formal and informal conversation, interview skills, reading, pronunciation, listening and of course on your speaking skills.

Do you need to write better emails, speak to international colleagues or attend meetings in English or German?

teacher_info.teaching_style:
I take this very serious & even though my lessons are always fun & easy going, I level you up, I push you up the mountain because I want to see you succeed. 

My main focus is improving your confidence & fluency in speaking because all the grammar is useless if you are too afraid to even stand up for yourself & talk. 

Once you schedule a trial lesson, I will determine your oral ability & we will talk about the areas you need to improve. 
We will also discuss how you can use the language in a way that you will enjoy, every single day - as this is the fastest way to improve.

FYI I take my lessons from wherever I am while still ensuring best quality 

I am excited to get to know you!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, students will learn how to introduce themselves, ask and answer simple questions, and engage in basic conversations in English. The focus is on improving speaking confidence, pronunciation, and sentence flow through everyday topics. This class does not follow a specific textbook or test, as it is designed to be practical and conversation-based. The lesson will include interactive dialogues, role-playing, and real-world scenarios to help students apply what they learn in daily life. Personalized corrections and feedback will be provided to ensure steady improvement.

For those who want a structured learning experience, the package includes multiple lessons covering different conversation topics such as greetings, ordering food, asking for directions, making requests, and small talk. Students will build vocabulary and fluency step by step with practical exercises and guided speaking practice.

pro_course_detail.title: English Pronunciation & Accent Improvement
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to help students improve their pronunciation and reduce their native accent for clearer communication. Students will focus on correcting difficult sounds, mastering vowel and consonant pronunciation, and refining intonation patterns to sound more natural. Instead of relying on a textbook, this class is customized to each student's pronunciation challenges and speaking goals. The teaching approach includes mouth shape and tongue placement exercises, minimal pairs practice, tongue twisters, and recorded feedback for self-practice.

For those looking for a more in-depth improvement, the package provides structured pronunciation training that covers individual sounds, word stress, sentence rhythm, and common pronunciation mistakes. Each lesson includes targeted exercises and personalized feedback to track progress effectively.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking with Confidence – Intermediate English
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for intermediate learners who want to express themselves more naturally and fluently in conversations. Students will work on expanding their vocabulary, using more complex sentence structures, and improving pronunciation. The focus is on practical speaking skills, including discussing opinions, telling stories, and handling social and professional interactions. While no textbook is required, materials such as articles, audio recordings, and discussion prompts will be used to enhance learning. The teaching approach includes conversation practice, interactive exercises, and feedback on grammar and pronunciation.

For those who want to advance further, the package includes lessons on different conversation topics such as travel, work, current events, and cultural discussions. Each session helps build confidence and fluency, making students more comfortable in various speaking situations.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English Mastery – Fluency & Precision
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is ideal for advanced learners who want to refine their English skills for professional, academic, or personal growth. Students will focus on improving fluency, accuracy, and natural expression in complex discussions and debates. The main focus is on advanced vocabulary, idiomatic expressions, nuanced grammar, and persuasive communication. Lessons are not based on a textbook but instead use authentic materials such as news articles, academic papers, TED Talks, and real-world case studies. Teaching methods include in-depth discussions, argument analysis, critical thinking exercises, and personalized feedback on pronunciation and grammar.

For a complete learning experience, the package includes multiple lessons focusing on advanced conversation strategies, professional communication, and effective writing skills. Each session is designed to push students beyond basic fluency and help them achieve mastery in English.

pro_course_detail.title: English Grammar Essentials
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to help students build a solid grammar foundation for both written and spoken English. It covers essential topics such as verb tenses, sentence structure, conditionals, articles, and prepositions, ensuring students can communicate clearly and correctly. The class does not rely on a specific textbook but follows internationally recognized English learning standards. Each session will include structured grammar exercises, real-life sentence applications, writing assignments, and interactive quizzes to reinforce learning. Personalized feedback and corrections will help students identify and correct common grammar mistakes.

For students looking for a structured learning path, the package offers multiple lessons focusing on different grammar topics, gradually building their confidence in applying rules naturally in conversations and writing.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Kids
pro_course_detail.description: In this lesson, young learners will develop their basic English skills through fun and engaging activities. They will learn how to greet others, introduce themselves, name common objects, and express simple ideas using easy vocabulary and sentences. The focus is on building confidence in speaking, improving pronunciation, and developing natural sentence flow. This class is interactive and play-based, using songs, stories, games, and role-playing exercises to make learning enjoyable. There is no strict textbook or test—just a relaxed, immersive environment where kids can practice English in a way that feels natural and exciting. Personalized feedback and gentle corrections will be provided to support their learning journey.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
☘️ I believe we are always learning and growing. Learning is like building blocks and I understand that it takes time. I am a patient and calm person, and will work together with the student at their current language abilities to reach their language goals. 

☘️ I aim to create a relaxed and supportive environment that helps students ease into their learning process. I encourage them to freely express themselves and see mistakes as part of learning. 

☘️ This will help us work together to improve their language skills and focus on their unique needs. It is important to me to allow their unique personalities to shine and making the learning journey enjoyable and rewarding.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
☘️ At the beginning of my journey with a student it is very important to establish what their goals are so that we tailor our classes to help reach their milestones. I adapt my teaching methods to the students and needs and pace as no student is the same, and have different needs with different abilities. I My lessons are relaxed and interactive. It is important to encourage/affirm the student and to provide feedback so as to better their language abilities. 

☘️ We will focus on your vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and reading and writing skills. I also provide conversational English practice, covering a range of topics to help students grow their confidence in speaking.

course_info.trial_description:
Hello and welcome to your free trial lesson 😀
This will be a relaxed and personalized lesson at your own pace, where I’ll introduce myself and get to know a little about you. 
Together, we will have a casual conversation for practice and enjoy a short activity. This will help me assess your language level and better understand your English language goals, including what you would like to learn or improve. 
This class is open to all children and adults, from beginner (A1) to mastery (C2) levels. 
I look forward to meeting you all 🤗

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice in English
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to help you develop fluency in the English language and communicate with confidence. 
Our sessions will involve open conversations on interesting, informative, or specific topics of your choice. These will take place in a relaxed environment, where I will provide support and feedback on your sentence construction, pronunciation, and grammar. 

In this class, there's plenty of room for self-expression and making mistakes, as I believe learning is a process of trying, growing, and improving.

pro_course_detail.title: English lessons for beginner and intermediate learners
pro_course_detail.description: In these lessons we will concentrate on developing and improving key English skills such as vocabulary, pronunciation, grammar, reading, and spelling. Lessons will be customized to the student’s current level, so you’ll feel confident as you build your vocabulary, learn how to pronounce words, and put together sentences effectively. We’ll also focus on reading and writing, making sure you progress step by step.  The goal is to create an enjoyable and engaging learning experience using educational and structured activities.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I’m a passionate and patient English tutor dedicated to helping students of all levels achieve their language goals. With a focus on creating engaging, interactive lessons, I tailor each session to your unique needs, whether you’re learning for travel, work, exams, or everyday communication.

My teaching style is supportive, encouraging, and fun. I believe in building confidence while making learning enjoyable. From beginners to advanced learners, I’m here to guide you every step of the way. Let’s work together to unlock your full potential in English!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons are interactive, engaging, and tailored to your goals. Whether you're learning conversational English, preparing for exams, improving business communication, or just starting out, I focus on practical skills you can use in real-life situations.

I use a mix of role-plays, discussions, games, and targeted exercises to make learning fun and effective. My approach is patient, supportive, and student-centered, ensuring you feel confident and motivated every step of the way.

Together, we’ll build your fluency, vocabulary, and confidence while having fun along the way. Let’s achieve your English goals. Book a lesson today!

course_info.trial_description:
Ready to start your English learning journey? Join me for a trial lesson and experience my teaching style firsthand! We’ll discuss your goals, assess your current level, and dive into a fun, interactive session tailored to your needs.

Whether you’re a beginner or looking to refine your skills, this is the perfect opportunity to see how we can work together to achieve your language goals. Let’s make learning English enjoyable and effective—book your trial lesson today!

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description: Boost your English fluency with engaging conversational classes designed for students of all levels! Tired of feeling stuck or struggling to express yourself confidently? I’m here to help you break through language barriers and become a confident communicator.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Exam Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Achieve your IELTS goals with my expert exam preparation sessions! As a seasoned tutor, I provide a tailored approach to help you succeed. My focus goes beyond memorization—I equip you with essential strategies, time management skills, and confidence-building techniques to ace the exam.

Together, we’ll break down each section of the IELTS, from reading and listening to writing and speaking. Through targeted exercises, practice tests, and personalized feedback, you’ll sharpen your skills and build the mindset needed for success.

Whether you're aiming for a high band score or overcoming exam anxiety, my sessions are designed to maximize your potential. Book today and take the first step toward turning your IELTS goals into achievements!
